source.text: Knockdown of KNTC1 in SK-Hep-1 and Huh7 significantly inhibited cell viability, migration ability and invasion ability. KNTC1 is involved in the regulation of hepatocellular carcinoma through its interaction with cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK1). Knockdown of KNTC1 inhibited CDK1 expression, while CDK1 overexpression was able to rescue the regulation of KNTC1 on the viability, migration and invasive ability of hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines.
